_note: Pre-registered event calendar for HS 8507.10 exports from Korea to the US. Fixed at Stage 0 close (2026-10-05). Any later change must be logged in docs/decision_log.md with a reason.

events.label: IEEPA reciprocal tariff 10% baseline effective; Korea-specific 25% took effect Apr 9 and was paused to 10% the same day
events.expected_effect: US-bound export volume drops after front-loading in Mar-Apr; unit price may rise if partially passed through

events.label: Korea-US agreement (Jul 30) implemented: 15% all-in rate
events.source: Executive Order of Jul 31, 2025; CRS IN12545
events.expected_effect: second step down in US-bound volume or further price adjustment

events.label: A Korean manufacturer announces US local production expansion 1.4M -> 3.0M units (AAPEX)
events.expected_effect: no immediate effect; sets up structural decline in Korea->US exports from late 2026

events.label: Supreme Court (Learning Resources v. Trump) invalidates IEEPA tariffs; Section 122 10% applies from Feb 24
events.source: Supreme Court opinion Feb 20, 2026; EO of Feb 20, 2026; law firm alerts (Ropes & Gray, WilmerHale)

events.label: Section 122 expires (150-day limit); replaced by Section 301 forced-labor tariff 10% / 12.5%
US local production 3.0M-unit expansion completion target
events.expected_effect: Korea->US exports begin to be displaced by local production (S3 US local production ramp scenario start)

not_applicable.label: Section 232 auto-parts 25% tariff
not_applicable.reason: Lead-acid batteries (HTS 8507.10) are reported NOT on the covered auto-parts list (dutiable.io, fact-checked 2026-10-03). Primary Annex I text not independently verified. Kept here so the exclusion is explicit.
